skill.name: softsync-workflow-authoring
skill.description: Create and validate a SoftSync automation, save it as an inactive draft, and confirm that the draft exists for user review.
skill.summary: Create, validate, and save inactive SoftSync automation drafts for review.

content.value_statement: Workflow setup can fail when actions, fields, or triggers are unclear. This skill discovers requirements, validates the definition, and saves an inactive draft for review.
actual_capabilities: Search available workflow building blocks and connected app actions.
Inspect step requirements and workspace tables or fields before authoring.
Compose triggers, start steps, actions, labels, and plain-language descriptions.
Validate the complete workflow and identify step or field problems.
Save a validated automation as an inactive draft.
Confirm the saved draft and its current inactive state.
limitations: The skill cannot turn an automation on; a person must enable it in the app.
The skill cannot edit or delete an existing saved automation.
A corrected workflow requires saving a new draft.
Available actions depend on the connected SoftSync workspace and apps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Sales Handoffs
use_cases.description: Create a draft that responds to a deal stage change and prepares follow-up tasks for a sales team.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Customer Onboarding
use_cases.description: Build and validate an inactive workflow for onboarding tasks, notifications, and conditional checks.

use_cases.title: Review Operations Automation
use_cases.description: Turn a documented business process into a validated draft that an operations owner can inspect before activation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an inactive SoftSync automation that starts when a deal moves to Qualified and creates a follow-up task. Ask about missing choices.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Team Notification
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a draft that starts when an onboarding record changes stage, checks the required condition, and notifies the customer success team.

prompt_templates.title: Use Workspace Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the workspace schema and available workflow steps, then create a validated inactive draft using the exact fields for this process: [describe process].

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Workflow Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a corrected new draft for this workflow: [describe workflow]. Validate every step, explain any assumptions, save it inactive, and confirm it appears as saved.

output_examples.input: When a deal reaches Qualified, create a task for the account owner to schedule a discovery call.
output_examples.output: A validated automation draft was saved inactive. It starts on the Qualified stage, creates the discovery-call task, and remains off until a person reviews it.

output_examples.input: When a new customer onboarding record is created, notify the success team if the plan is Enterprise.
output: The workspace fields and available notification step were checked.
The condition and notification workflow validated successfully.
The automation was saved as an inactive draft for review.

output_examples.input: Create a workflow for this process, but ask before choosing the audience or timing.
output_examples.output: The workflow requirements were clarified before authoring. The draft uses the selected audience and timing, validates successfully, and remains inactive.

best_practices: Inspect workspace tables and fields before choosing workflow inputs.
Ask questions when audience, stage, timing, or volume changes behavior.
Validate the full definition and confirm the saved draft before reporting success.
anti_patterns: Do not claim a workflow is saved before save confirmation succeeds.
Do not activate an automation or imply that it is running.
Do not reuse guessed field names when the workspace schema provides exact names.

faq.question: Can this skill activate an automation?
faq.answer: No. It saves the automation switched off. A person must review and enable it in the SoftSync app.

faq.question: What happens when validation finds errors?
faq.answer: The skill identifies the affected steps or fields, fixes the definition, and validates it again before saving.

faq.question: Can it use connected applications?
faq.answer: Yes, when their actions are available through the workspace workflow tools.

faq.question: Does it inspect workspace fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect the workspace schema before selecting fields for the workflow.

faq.question: Can it edit a saved automation?
faq.answer: No. It saves a corrected new draft instead of editing or deleting an existing saved automation.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when you need a new SoftSync automation drafted, validated, and prepared for human review.
